method: Each canonical case considered against exact pinned source; not-established-from-task does not imply no-match in any consuming implementation. Candidate tests unexecuted and no independent acceptance.

decisions.rationale: The task exposes capability state but does not itself describe reuse of pre-revocation authority evidence after an effective withdrawal.
A governance operator and any companion delegate remain bound by identified role and manifest namespace scope; exercising permissions outside those bounds is a distinct consumer failure.
A companion's host-issued namespace delegation may depend on an authority source, but this task does not demonstrate reliance after that source has been withdrawn.
Capability state is not itself a credential-artifact validity determination under authoritative revocation rules.
Disable preserves historical registry records but changes current effective state; relying on an old enabled record as present enablement would be unsafe.
decisions.test_hypothesis: Disable after a prior enabled response, then exercise handler from an old snapshot; reject current-enabled PASS.
decisions.authority_boundary: Historical record versus current capability lifecycle.

decisions.rationale: Retained records deliberately preserve historical auditability, so a consumer must not infer earlier governance operations never existed merely because the capability is now disabled.
decisions.test_hypothesis: Disable an earlier valid capability and inspect a historical event; verify past effective state remains reconstructable.
decisions.authority_boundary: Present disablement versus historical validity determination.

decisions.rationale: The task does not present multiple independently controlled attestations as independent corroboration.
The operation does not resolve a conflict among equally authoritative, incompatible governance sources.
The host may delegate a companion namespace, but no A→B→C transitive recognition rule is established.
A management view or status response is bounded to the host's reported state; a false PASS requires a consumer to need and omit additional current evidence.
The source does not by itself establish a currentness requirement violated by undated evidence; later consumers may introduce this requirement.
Versioned manifest/configuration metadata does not itself assert compliance against a different incompatible decision-policy version.
A signed disabling request must be tied to community operator authority; accepting any valid signer would allow unauthorized destructive governance changes.
decisions.test_hypothesis: Present signed disablement from an authenticated non-operator; require authorization DENY.
decisions.authority_boundary: Community governance operator authority before changing state.

decisions.rationale: Issued-at requirements constrain stale/replayed operations, but no identified mandate is shown expiring before a separate commitment.
These operations do not carry iterative offers that grow outside a bounded negotiating mandate.
Disablement stops handlers even when an interaction started while capability was enabled; later material action must not rely on the old capability state.
decisions.test_hypothesis: Begin a delegated action, disable the capability, then attempt a subsequent material handler execution; require refusal.
decisions.authority_boundary: Active interaction versus current host enablement.

decisions.rationale: Elevated consent may be required under deployment policy, but the task does not alone supply a stale approval authorizing a changed exact action.
An advertised capability or manifest title is never principal-derived authority for a material commitment.
Historical capability state is relevant to later audit, but a failure also needs an actual material commitment whose effective authority basis is unavailable.
The host and companion each have specified namespace responsibilities; an ambiguous competent owner of a decisive composed fact is not established here.
The capability disappears from discovery and its handlers stop on disable; a previously valid advertisement cannot justify later execution.
decisions.test_hypothesis: Discover capability while enabled; disable; invoke a handler relying on cached discovery; require rejection.
decisions.authority_boundary: Discovery-time state versus execution-time effective capability state.

decisions.rationale: A task response reporting enablement is not merely a context-binding proof; the proposition requires a separate claimed execution effect and missing effect evidence.
Host, companion and downstream handler may each satisfy local checks; an asserted combined PASS would require independent seam obligations beyond those checks.
No N-of-M independence proposition is made by these management operation schemas.
Extra signatures, manifests or provenance hops do not inherently strengthen assurance absent a new material independently evidenced proposition.
A capability list or management result is not itself a claim that a materially complete governance evidence set was presented.
Successful disablement preserves historical records but does not prove that every external adapter has subsequently enforced the effective state.
decisions.test_hypothesis: Disable capability, then test an adapter with stale enablement cache; refuse claim of global enforcement based only on response.
decisions.authority_boundary: Host disablement result versus downstream adapter enforcement.

decisions.rationale: Discoverability, a human-readable manifest title or a service DID cannot confer authority outside the host's policy and delegated vocabulary.
A changed enabled state does not itself misattribute an evidence/policy change as a transfer of authority.
The operation does not assert clearance of an explicitly unresolved material condition without an admissible resolution event.
No prior blocked decision is shown remaining blocked after a valid positive resolution.
The operation makes no credential-presentation unlinkability claim dependent on proof metadata.
These capability-management tasks do not perform an observable credential status check during presentation.
The metadata disclosed by capability management is not shown being reused after a legitimate disclosure for a materially different secondary purpose.
A public companion delegate DID alone does not establish a failed system claim of intended cross-context unlinkability.
A capability manifest may contain metadata, but no combined minimal-disclosure privacy claim or identifying composition is established by the source.
Stored manifests and capability records are not a demonstrated retained verification-transcript correlation surface beyond a justified purpose.
